subject: Pilot discovery — recap & proposed milestones
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@evergreenhealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T16:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot discovery — recap & proposed milestones

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap of what we heard and a suggested mutual action plan to keep momentum. Please flag anything we've missed.

Key pain points you called out:
- High latency on internal summarization pipeline (up to 6s/token on peak queries) causing poor clinician UX.
- Cost runway concerns as usage scales and model choices vary across departments.
- Need for auditable logs for downstream clinical QA and compliance.

Goals you prioritized:
1) Bring average p99 latency under 500ms for the summarization endpoint during peak traffic in the ED triage flow.
2) Establish a 3-month pilot with measurable cost-per-transaction and quality guardrails.
3) Validate data handling & retention for auditability with your security team.

Proposed milestones (high level):
- Week 1 (Oct 27): Pilot scope & access — exchange test accounts, dataset samples, security questionnaire answers.
- Week 2–3 (Nov 3): Baseline run in Redwood Dedicated sandbox; latency & cost baseline.
- Week 5 (Nov 17): Iteration with caching/quantization recommendations; 2nd benchmark.
- Week 8 (Dec 8): Executive demo; decision gate for scale / procurement.

Owners (Redwood / Evergreen):
- Redwood: Grace (pilot orchestration), Ben (inference performance lead), Vanessa (security & compliance).
- Evergreen: Samantha (product sponsor), Tom (technical sponsor / integration).

Decision criteria you mentioned: p99 latency target, cost per 1k transactions, and clear answers on data access/retention for audit logs.

Attachments: initial MPA draft and a short scope questionnaire attached for your IT/security and product teams to review.

Next steps I propose:
1) Samantha — share the shortlist of datasets and the contact for your InfoSec (if different from Tom) by end of week (Oct 23).
2) Redwood (Ben) — will send a short runbook for the Dedicated sandbox and a preliminary cost-band estimate.
3) Schedule a 30-minute tech sync for next Tuesday (Oct 26) to confirm access.

If this looks right, I'll lock the dates and send an updated MPA with ownership table and doc links.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Subject: Re: Pilot discovery — recap & proposed milestones

Thanks Grace — this is very close to what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Data & security: Tom will be our technical sponsor and main point for InfoSec questions; I'll loop in our compliance reviewer (K. Patel) once we have the questionnaire answers.
- Timeline: We are tight on November executive reviews; if we can push the exec demo to Dec 1 instead of Dec 8, that helps align with our board meeting cadence.
- Decision process: Product (me) recommends -> Tech sponsor (Tom) validates -> Procurement signs off (approx 2 week window after exec demo).

We will:
1) Share two sample de-identified transcripts and the contact for compliance by Oct 23 EOD.
2) Confirm attendees for the Oct 26 tech sync (Tom + one engineer).

One ask: can Redwood provide a short note on how KV/prefix caching affects consistency for clinical summarization? That will help Tom evaluate quality tradeoffs.

Onward — appreciate the clear milestones.

Best,
Samantha Li
Senior Product Manager, Digital Health | Evergreen Health
samantha.li@evergreenhealth.com

Grace / Vanessa — quick internal note before I reply to Evergreen:

- On the cost band: preliminary estimate for the pilot (50k tokens/day average) is $X–$Y / month depending on caching settings. I'll prepare two scenarios: aggressive caching vs conservative (no prefix caching) so we can show cost/quality tradeoffs.
- On latency: our Dedicated sandbox can replicate p50/p95 but p99 depends a lot on burst patterns. We'll include a short guidance doc for the sandbox config that Garry (infra) can stand up.
- Vanessa — can you confirm the standard NDA / security questionnaire turn time so we can manage Evergreen's procurement expectation?

I'll draft the short technical note on caching + consistency for Grace to attach.

Samantha / Tom — thanks for the quick replies and the timeline note. Updated MPA summary below (concise) and next steps. I attached the MPA v1 and the short caching note Ben referenced.

Mutual Action Plan (concise)
- Goal: Validate production-likely settings that meet p99 < 500ms for the summarization endpoint and keep cost per transaction below the agreed band.

Milestones & Dates
1) Access & data handoff — Oct 23 (Evergreen: share de-identified samples; Redwood: provide sandbox access).
2) Baseline run & initial metrics — Nov 3 (Redwood runs baseline; share p50/p95/p99 and cost snapshot).
3) Optimization iteration — Nov 10 (apply caching/quantization; second benchmark).
4) Exec demo & procurement prep — Dec 1 (move exec demo earlier per Evergreen request).

Owners
- Evergreen: Samantha (product owner), Tom (tech sponsor), Procurement contact (TBD).
- Redwood: Grace (pilot lead), Ben (performance/benchmarks), Vanessa (security & docs).

Decision gates (what Evergreen will evaluate)
- Latency: p99 latency target met in sandbox under representative load.
- Cost: projected cost per 1k transactions within agreed band.
- Compliance: security questionnaire answered and logs retention model acceptable to Evergreen compliance.

Attachments included:
- redwood-mpa-draft-v1.pdf (MPA with ownership table)
- pilot-scope-questions.xlsx (data & security questions)
- caching-consistency-note.pdf (short explanation on caching vs consistency)

Next steps (action owners):
- Samantha: share datasets & compliance contact by Oct 23.
- Ben: send caching-consistency-note and cost scenarios by Oct 22.
- Grace: schedule tech sync for Oct 26 at 10:00 PT and update the MPA in Drive.

If that's agreeable I'll add the procurement lane to the MPA and circulate a calendar invite for the tech sync.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to moving ahead.

Grace O'Connor
